Security


PropertyList.es Security: Your Data is in Safe Hands

At PropertyList.es, we prioritise the security of your personal and property information. Our platform is fortified with state-of-the-art security technologies to ensure your data remains safe and secure.

Top-Notch Security Measures:


Cloudflare Protection:

We leverage Cloudflare’s advanced security solutions to shield our network from malicious attacks and ensure seamless, secure access to our services.
  • Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Adding an extra layer of security, MFA helps protect your account by requiring multiple forms of verification before granting access.
  • Intrusion Detection and Firewalls: Our networks are designed with robust intrusion detection systems and firewalls to monitor and block unauthorised access attempts.
  • Regular Penetration Testing: We conduct frequent penetration tests to identify and address potential vulnerabilities, ensuring our defences are always up to date.
  • 24/7 Monitoring: Our security team continuously monitors our systems to detect and respond to any suspicious activity in real-time.

With these comprehensive security measures in place, you can trust that your data on PropertyList.es is protected against hackers and other threats. Your privacy and security are our top priorities, and we are committed to maintaining a safe and secure environment for all our users.

Stay connected and stay secure with PropertyList.es.


PLEAE NOTE:
PropertyList does not have access to any contacts, property documents, or pipeline info. This ensures that your information remains secure within your office account. However, please be careful when deleting any items, as we are unable to retrieve deleted information either.
